theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (D F : Set (Euclid P)) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen D → MeasurableSet F → μ Dᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ D → μ K ≠ ∞) → Measurable ν → (∀ z, ‖ν z‖ = 1) → (∀ φ : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ D → ∫ z in F, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) = -∫ z, inner ℝ (φ z) (ν z) ∂μ) → ∀ ζ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ D → (∀ z, 0 ≤ ζ z) → ∀ g : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 g → HasCompactSupport g → (∀ z, ‖g z‖ ≤ 1) → |∫ z, F.indicator ζ z * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (fderiv ℝ g z : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)| ≤ ∫ z, ζ z ∂μ + ∫ z in F, ‖fderiv ℝ ζ z‖
